name: IDCloudHost Cloud VPS

evidence.vps: 03: hosted VPS; IDCloudHost provides the VM and the customer administers the OS and apps

line: Provision a virtual private server with self-managed operating system and apps.

free.text: No recurring free Cloud VPS plan

cells.regions: Indonesia and Singapore; price region not stated

work.math: Rp 87,000 a month known VM subtotal. The public IPv4 rate and whether tax is included are not published, so the full total is unknown.
A VM with 2 cores and 2 GB is Rp 87,000 a month (hourly alternative Rp 87,600). The IPv4 price and whether tax is included are unknown.
Rp 225,000 a month for a VM with 2 cores and 4 GB. Database, daily 7-day backups, IPv4, tax and 10 GB traffic terms are not priced.
